title: selaginella pumila
intro: Selaginella pumila, commonly known as the dwarf spike moss or miniature spikemoss, is a small, evergreen plant species belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of infections and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Selaginella pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
